# Board

1. Find the Orc-istration checkout: the "Setup checkout (this machine)" line in the rulebook's tool notes, else `setupCheckout` in `config.json` (under `ORC_DATA_DIR` when set, else under `~/.orc/`), else ask the user. Call it CHECKOUT and confirm `CHECKOUT/orchestration/board.md` exists there; if it does not, stop and say so.
2. Read `CHECKOUT/orchestration/board.md` and follow it.
3. On Antigravity this skill is also the slash command `/board`. There is no subagent-stop hook here, so update the board session yourself after every agent report. The artifact backend can be written only from Claude Code; use a local board here.
